WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT l.ID, p.SEX,
           AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb,
           AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
), sex_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX,
           AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb,
           AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(SEX) <> ''
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       avg_alb,
       avg_un_tbil_ratio,
       avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean
FROM sex_averages
WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages);
